verdict.rationale: Persona exposes verification outcomes programmatically. Webhooks deliver real-time approved, declined, or needs-review statuses, and the API can be polled for inquiry statuses and specific verification details, which gives an automated flow coarse outcomes to branch on. Report types (Watchlist, PEP, Adverse Media) and workflows that tag high-risk inquiries add risk signals, but the evidence never shows the structure of per-check results or failure reasons. Missing for 10: documented per-check result fields and failure-reason codes, explicit risk score or signal schema in API/webhook payloads, independent or hands-on corroboration.
